text: Hello, boys and girls, I'm Helen.Welcome to my English class.Today, we are going to have assessments, period 2, talking about my family.And you are going to finish the assessments by yourself with the help of this table.First, let's review the sounds.Please look and read by yourself.Quite good.Now, let's think and read these sounds and words by yourself.Please follow me.dask as ksk,clasp as psp,most as tst,push as hsh,drop d-r-j,press p-r-p-r,break b-r-p-r,cross c-r-q-r,Now, finish assessment 1 by yourself, 1 star or 2 stars.Today, we are going to finish project 2, my family.Please open your student's book, turn to page 65.Jill will give you an example.Let's follow her step by step.First, make a family tree.Please draw your family tree and say something about your family.Then, finish assessment 2 by yourself.Look, Jill is thinking about her family.She has a big family.She can draw her family tree and then introduce her family.Listen.Look at my mother, my uncle, my aunt, my cousin and me.Look at my grandparents.They are very nice.This is my father.He is tall and strong.This is my mother.She is beautiful.Look at my uncle and my aunt.They are both tall.This is my cousin.He is short and thin.This is me.I love my family very much.Thank you, Jill.Now, it's your turn.Don't forget to take out your stationery, draw and say.She is tall and strong.Now, please finish assessment two by yourself.One star or two stars.Next, think about your family members.Take and say.Then finish assessment three by yourself.I will ask Jill some questions about her family.Jill, do you have any brothers and sisters?No, I don't.But I have a cousin.So, I take here.Do you have any uncles and aunts?Yes, I have one uncle and one aunt.So, Jill, you have one uncle, one aunt and one cousin.Am I right?Yes, I have one uncle, one aunt and one cousin.Please think, take and say.Please finish assessment three by yourself.Good.Now, please turn your student's book to page 66.Think and write the names of these jobs.Then finish assessment four by yourself.What jobs do these pictures stand for?Please think and write.Color the pictures after class.Now, let's check the answers.Please read these words by yourself.Finish assessment four by yourself.Do you still remember these words?Now, we can introduce more about our family members.Please turn your student's book to page 67.Please write about your family members.We can write more information about them, such as job, appearance, abilities, clothes and so on.Look.Jill can stick the photos of her family members and then write about them.Please read by yourself.After class, you can stick the photos of them.After writing, you can introduce your family members.Tell your classmates about your family members, then finish assessment five by yourself.Now, let's listen to Jill.Please tell your classmates about your family members by using these patterns.Please finish assessment five by yourself.In today's class, we have finished the assessments about sounds, vocabulary, sentence patterns and the topics.Good job, boys and girls.The assignments for today, review project two on page 65 to 67 of your student's book, number one to number five.So much for today.Goodbye, boys and girls.See you next time.
